About.title: About
About.subtitle: Learn about the BURY
About.whatIsBuryDesc1: BURY is a decentralized mining game and value-storage protocol built on Solana.
About.whatIsBuryDesc2: Designed with fair mining and fair distribution at its core, it leverages on-chain randomness and an automated buyback system to create a trustless and sustainably growing token economy.
About.whatIsBuryDesc3: While decentralized blockchains offer a trustless global financial system, most value tokens still rely on intermediaries or cross-chain bridges, introducing asset risks and liquidity constraints.
About.whatIsBuryDesc4: BURY runs natively on the ORE Chain, featuring a fully on-chain mining and buyback mechanism with no third-party custody required.
About.whatIsBuryDesc5: It is not only a gamified fair-mining mechanism, but also a self-reinforcing value-storage model — every mining action and every round of results contribute to the ecosystem's ongoing refinement and accumulation.
About.miningMechanismDesc: Each round lasts 1 minute, and the system randomly selects 1 winning cell from a 5×5 grid:
About.miningPoint1: Users deposit ORE into any cell — choosing one, multiple, or all cells;
About.miningPoint2: Two modes: Manual (one-round mining) or Auto-mine (continuous rounds with upfront ORE deduction);
About.miningPoint3: A 1% fee is charged on the mining amount.
About.resultDistributionDesc1: A winner is drawn every minute using on-chain randomness;
About.resultDistributionDesc2: If no one participates, or if the winning cell has no deposits, the round is void with no distribution.
About.normalWinPoint1: Receive 90% of the round's ORE prize pool (distributed by deposit share);
About.normalWinPoint2Sub1: 50% chance → one random winner receives it all;
About.normalWinPoint2Sub2: 50% chance → distributed among all winners proportionally.
About.motherlodePoint1: +0.2 BURY is added to the Motherlode every round;
About.motherlodePoint3: If untriggered, it accumulates until released in full to winners, using the same distribution logic.
About.refiningDesc1: When users claim their unclaimed BURY mining rewards, a 10% refining fee is deducted.
About.refiningDesc2: These fees are redistributed to other miners who still have unclaimed BURY, injecting proportional rewards into the Refining Pool.
About.refiningDesc3: When these miners later claim their rewards, the additional BURY from the Refining Pool is not charged again.
About.refiningMeaningDesc: The longer users wait to claim, the more refining bonuses they receive — rewarding long-term holders with compounding gains.
About.stakingDesc: BURY holders can stake to earn protocol revenue:
About.stakingPoint1: 10% of all ORE spent on mining is automatically used for protocol buybacks;
About.stakingPoint2Sub1: 90% goes to the Bury Pool for future distribution;
About.stakingPoint2Sub2: 10% goes to the Staking Pool for stakers;
About.stakingPoint3: Stakers receive rewards in real time based on their share of total staked BURY;
About.stakingBenefitsDesc: price appreciation from buybacks + continuous staking rewards.
About.tokenomicsDistribution: Distribution: 100% fair mining, no team or reserved allocation
About.tokenomicsVoidProtection: Void protection: No output if the round has no participants or no winner deposits
About.tokenomicsBuybackPoint1: 10% of every round's mining ORE is used for automated BURY buybacks;
About.tokenomicsRefiningPoint1: 10% refining fee when claiming mining rewards;
About.pointsSystemDesc: To reward long-term engagement, BURY features a unique points mechanism.
About.pointsEarningRule1: After each round, non-winning users receive points;
About.pointsEarningRule2: Winning users do not receive points.
About.pointsFutureUtility2: Participating in governance or community events;
About.pointsFutureUtility3: Unlocking tiers, benefits, or exclusive features.
About.pointsFinalNote: Even in "unlucky rounds," users continue accumulating long-term value through points.
About.coreValueDesc: BURY integrates mining, buybacks, refining, staking, and points into a unified decentralized economy — a system where players both play and accumulate value.
About.coreValueFairness: Fairness: All results powered by on-chain randomness
About.coreValueSustainability: Sustainability: Buybacks and refining create a self-balancing loop
About.coreValueIncentive: Incentive Alignment: Even losing rounds provide growth through points
About.coreValueSloganText: "Mine for fun. Bury for value. Earn points to grow."
About.mintDesc: The mint address uniquely identifies the ORE token on the Solana blockchain.
About.treasuryDesc: The protocol treasury is a smart contract account which has the sole authority to mint new ORE tokens. It additionally manages all refined ORE, unrefined ORE, and ORE staking yield held by the protocol.
